Normal prior on natural mortality

get_natmort_prior.Rd

Called once from the "Natural Mortality (Prior)" section of SPoRC_rtmb.R.

Usage

get_natmort_prior(M_prior, ln_M, M_blocks)

Arguments

M_prior

Data frame with columns popblk, regionblk, yearblk, ageblk, sexblk (block indices into M_blocks), mu (prior mean, natural scale), sd (prior SD, log scale), one row per penalized parameter.

ln_M

Vector of estimated log natural mortality values, indexed by M_blocks.

M_blocks

Array [pop, region, year, age, sex] mapping each population/region/year/age/sex cell to an index into ln_M.

Value

Numeric scalar negative log-likelihood contribution, summed across all rows of M_prior.
